sequence.action: Exhaust public manufacturer-controlled sources and current authorized-distributor lifecycle data.
Compare fully documented replacements and reject any option that degrades an accepted function or creates a larger uncontrolled risk.
Request missing controlled drawings or written mating data from the manufacturer without placing an order.
Only if the preceding routes fail, prepare a smallest-possible evidence-sample proposal for separate user approval.

subjects.selected: EastRising ER-TFT035IPS-6 configured with ER-TPC035-6 capacitive touch/controller
subjects.selection_scope: exact orderable production LCD/CTP assembly for the one factory-assembled prototype
subjects.production_identity_rule: The exact manufacturer drawing, 50-contact map, lifecycle, configured quantity-one price, current stock and customer-supplied-parts route control H1; H5 still obtains written JLCPCB acceptance for adhesive placement, FPC insertion and final mating.

official_findings.finding: EastRising controls the 54.50x83.00-mm LCD, 56.54x84.96-mm configured CTP outline, folded 50-contact 0.50-mm FPC, ILI9488 i8080-8 strap and every display/touch/power contact.
ER-TFT035IPS-6 is in stock and exact option 5344 adds ER-TPC035-6 with FT6236 at quantity one; configured material price is USD 14.91.
Exact HRS FH34SRJ-50S-0.5SH(50), C3169104, is an Extended SMT Economic/Standard-PCBA part with 2,614 orderable, MOQ 1 and USD 0.5832 quantity-one price on 2026-08-29.
The active DF40C(2.0)-40DS-0.4V(51) fixes the main-board 40-contact receptacle and exact 2.0-mm stack independently of the raw display tail. The former (58) order code differs only in reel quantity.
The active DF40C-40DP-0.4V(51) is the exact mating 40-contact adapter-board plug.

subjects.remaining_gap: No display geometry or order identity remains open. H5 must obtain written factory acceptance for customer-supplied panel handling, adhesive placement, FPC insertion and final mating; this is a process/quote gate, not a layout ambiguity.

replacement_review.reason: It is orderable and dimensioned but uses 4-wire SPI, is 61.00x92.44 mm and does not preserve direct i8080 video throughput.
It has an excellent controlled drawing and lifecycle surface, but uses RGB/4-line SPI, a 50-contact tail, a 59.56x93.34x5.66-mm body and a 13.5-17 V backlight.
It preserves a fast serial path through AXS15231B, but the raw LCD/CTP assembly still lacks a separately controlled order identity and flex drawing, reproducing the same procurement gap.
The exact IPS panel preserves 320x480 capacitive touch and direct i8080-8 video, while the passive 50-to-40 adapter isolates any future panel change from the main PCB.

official_findings.finding: The current Ebyte specification fixes the 12x19-mm module, nRF24L01+ function, IPX external interface and recommends Ebyte's 2.4-GHz IPX antenna family.

The official Altium PcbLib contains the exact PE01-ML01IPX land pattern and body outline. Binary primitive extraction confirms that it does not contain the RF receptacle body or axis, so H1 must reserve the complete module-face endpoint zone rather than infer a coordinate.
Ebyte identifies its mating 2.4-GHz antenna interface as IPX/IPEX generation 1.
TE 2118651-2 is an active 30-mm UMCC Gen1-to-Gen1 assembly with full drawing and CAD data.
TE cross-references UMCC Gen1/MHF1 to Hirose U.FL-R-SMT-1(10); authorized-distributor stock exists for 2118651-2.

subjects.remaining_gap: Ebyte does not publish the receptacle axis or manufacturer's exact MPN; H1 uses a conservative module-face route reserve, while current-lot axis, identity and fit remain incoming-inspection items.

replacement_review.candidate: 3x bare Nordic NRF24L01P-R7 with local RF matching
replacement_review.reason: The chip and reference layout are fully controlled and currently orderable, but Nordic marks the family not recommended for new designs; direct RF integration also creates three new matching/layout qualifications.

replacement_review.candidate: Ebyte E01-ML01DP5 or E01-2G4M27D with SMA-K
replacement_review.reason: The larger high-power PA/LNA modules change current, RF output, coexistence risk and the accepted compact three-radio layout.

subjects.selected: M5Stack U214 with Samtec HLE-107-02-G-DV-PE-LC pass-through host socket

official_findings.finding: M5Stack controls the U214 84x24x15.2-mm product envelope, 14-contact Cap-Bus map, mating products and current application.
The model-size drawing controls the 84-mm width, 24-mm depth, 15.287-mm maximum thickness and 56-mm retention pitch.
The official schematic identifies P1 as a 14-position 2.54-mm SMD header and controls every contact.
The reference host exposes an EXT 2.54-14P bus with the matching electrical pin map.

The exact active HLE configuration is a vertical 2x7 2.54-mm through-hole socket with pass-through entry and locking clips; Samtec lists it as an Extended Life Product and publishes current stock and pricing.

The controlled HLE series data accepts the standard 0.635-mm square-post class from 1.78-mm minimum insertion and does not impose the closed-end bottoming maximum that made the previous socket dependent on undocumented U214 post length.

subjects.remaining_gap: M5Stack still does not name the fitted male header or guarantee current-lot post section, insertion force or lifecycle. The unknown values remain design-analysis inputs; H5 uses ordinary assembly/disassembly, continuity and retention inspection rather than a prescribed force or cycle qualification.

replacement_review.candidate: generic alternative LoRa module or E22 carrier
replacement_review.reason: It loses direct compatibility with the accepted U214/Cardputer Cap ecosystem and does not remove the need for a controlled removable mechanical interface.
The pass-through contact removes unknown post-length bottoming from the retained dock-height geometry while preserving the 2x7 2.54-mm Cap-Bus, active lifecycle and near-identical cost.
It preserves topology but requires 4.34-mm minimum insertion versus HLE's 1.78 mm, giving less tolerance to the still-undocumented U214 post.
